records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/bobbin/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Farchitecture%2Foverview.md#architecture-overview
records.summary: Bobbin keeps code context local: structural parsing supplies file and symbol pointers, local embeddings supply semantic retrieval, and temporal coupling supplies change context.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/bobbin/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Farchitecture%2Foverview.md#query-pipeline
records.summary: Search combines semantic and keyword retrieval; context assembly adds related files rather than treating a search hit as the complete task context.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/bobbin/src%2Fcli%2Fmod.rs
records.summary: The Commands enum defines the public command surface, including search, context and portable index pack operations.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/bobbin/src%2Fmcp%2Fserver.rs
records.summary: The MCP server advertises the tool interface; defining source is the authority for tool names, inputs and feature conditions.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/bobbin/src%2Fhttp%2Fmod.rs
records.summary: The HTTP module defines the public REST service and route composition; it is distinct from the stdio MCP transport.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/bobbin/src%2Fconfig.rs
records.summary: Configuration types define keys and defaults, including embedding.backend, embedding.model and embedding.batch_size.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/bobbin/src%2Fcli%2Fpack.rs
records.summary: Portable Bobbin index packs are a separate file format from Quipu repository pendants; pack operations are defined here.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/code/bobbin/src%2Fknowledge%2Fmod.rs
records.summary: The optional knowledge feature integrates with the Quipu crate. This dependency is not an identity assertion between the two repositories.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/bobbin/CONTRIBUTING.md#feature-integration-checklist
records.summary: New retrieval signals must be considered for context assembly and its MCP and CLI interfaces. The published contributor checklist is the source of this active guidance.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/bobbin/README.md
records.summary: Start with installation and the first successful search, then read architecture and contributor guidance.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/bobbin/docs%2Fbook%2Fsrc%2Farchitecture%2Foverview.md
records.summary: Read the architecture overview for the indexing, search and optional knowledge graph boundaries.

records.subject: http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/doc/bobbin/CONTRIBUTING.md
records.summary: Read contributor gates and the feature integration checklist before changing retrieval behavior.
